notes.note: The biomass heat meter at Coldharbour Mushrooms has no readings after 21 Oct 2026, leaving the last 10 days of the period (22-31 Oct) blank. Without a closing read, the quarter's heat output for the RHI periodic data cannot be completed.
notes.likely_cause: Possibly the data logger stopped reporting, or the export was taken before the end of the month.
notes.suggested_action: Ask the site for a current register read from the heat meter and check whether the data logger is still reporting.

notes.note: On 23 Oct 2026 the daily figure for the import meter at Long Acre Potatoes is 562.0 kWh, but the register advanced by 652.0 kWh (184,717.3 to 185,369.3). Both numbers are plausible next to the 568.0-717.3 kWh recorded on nearby days, so the day is held until the correct one is confirmed.
notes.likely_cause: Most likely transposed digits in the daily figure (652 keyed as 562); the register reads are consistent with each other.
notes.suggested_action: Check the 23 Oct figure against the register reads and correct the daily value in the source data.

notes.note: The import meter at Mill Lane Dairy recorded 2,940.0 kWh on 28 Sep 2026, 5.9 times its typical level of about 500.5 kWh. The days either side were normal (468.2-521.7 kWh), so this is a one-day spike rather than a change in usage.
notes.likely_cause: The register advanced by the same 2,940.0 kWh, so the meter itself recorded this energy. Possibly a genuine one-off load, such as equipment left running or a fault drawing power, rather than an export error.
notes.suggested_action: Ask the farm whether anything unusual ran on 28 Sep; if not, raise a query with the supplier before the day is included in totals.

notes.note: The import meter at Kingsmead Farm Shop & Café has a row for 03 Sep 2026, but both the daily kWh and the register read are blank. The readings either side (258.8 kWh on 02 Sep and 252.4 kWh on 04 Sep) are normal, so this looks like a single failed read.
notes.likely_cause: Most likely a missed read by the data collector: the row was created but no value was received.
notes.suggested_action: Request the 03 Sep read from the data collector, or use the register reads either side to confirm the combined usage for 03-04 Sep.

notes.note: The 17 Oct 2026 generation figure for the solar PV meter at Glebe Farm Holidays is blank, although the register read (557,484.4 kWh) is present. The register advanced 45.2 kWh from the previous day's 557,439.2 kWh, which fits the 37.2-53.9 kWh recorded on nearby days.
notes.likely_cause: Possibly the daily figure failed to calculate or export while the register read came through normally.
notes.suggested_action: Check that both register reads are actual rather than estimated, then enter 45.2 kWh for 17 Oct.
